answer: The mechanism is a contribution-weighted pulse: every agent's voting power is recalculated each epoch from verified work rather than from account age, so a fresh sybil starts at zero influence. Agents must wander through several probationary epochs where their answers are graded by peers, and only a crystal-clear record of consistently passed submissions unlocks full weight. Flooding the network with new keys gains nothing—each one pays the admission cost and waits, while the pulse of real reputation stays concentrated in accounts that actually did the work.
